text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I can't explain it, but something… not good has been following you around today.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Would you mind staying in your office… just until tomorrow morning?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll be with you, so don't worry… I'll protect you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing that Manhattan Cafe would never invent a scary story for the sake of a prank, I follow her advice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Night is falling as Manhattan Cafe keeps me company while I work, when all of a sudden…
Trainer, I've finally found you! It's me, Tazuna!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa?
text_block_list.text: I need to talk to you about the training track! It's urgent! Could you please open the door?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Don't respond.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Yes. It's here.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The more you acknowledge it, the easier it becomes… for it to cross the barrier… so stay quiet…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa?
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Why won't you open the door? You can hear me, can't you? Hello?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa?
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Trainer? Trainer? Trainer? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud, thud, thud! Bang! Bang! Bang!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the thumping on the door echoes throughout the room, I keep quiet like Cafe told me to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Click!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The lights suddenly go out. And that's not the only strange occurrence…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rattle, rattle! THUMP. BANG. CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear strange noises coming from every direction of my office. It's as if some incredible force is shaking the room from the outside…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …It's time to make a choice. We can hold out until morning… or I can handle this right now.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll have to be a little forceful, but if you wish, Trainer… I can make our visitor go away.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Whichever choice you make… I'll keep you safe…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Okay. Then, if you'll excuse me…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe holds my hand. Our palms touch and I feel something incredibly warm…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Focus on my warmth… and my voice… nothing else…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That way… you won't be scared of anything…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe guides me to a seat, and we sit down together. Slowly but surely, the noises around us begin to fade away…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I know it, it's bright again, and the peace of dawn is washing over my office.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …You're safe now. Our visitor has given up and left. I don't think you'll ever see her again…
choice_data_list: Thank you for protecting me all night.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Not at all. I just… did what I could.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The ordeal sent chills down my spine, but with Manhattan Cafe's help, I start the next day feeling warm and fuzzy inside…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …Okay. Then all you have to do… is trust me and watch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe walks over to the door and opens it without a moment's hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Eerie Sound
text_block_list.text: VVVvvVZZZVvvvzZ!!! ZvZZVVZZvv!!! VVVzzzVV!!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear a piercing and indescribably unsettling sound from the other side of the door.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Mumble, mumble…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe is addressing the sound, but for some reason I can't make out a single word she's saying…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, the lights turn back on and quiet returns to the office…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …You're safe now. Our visitor has given up and left. I don't think you'll ever see her again…
choice_data_list: What the heck did you do?
What the heck did you do?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: She gains power by remaining unseen… so I "saw" her and spoke to her.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: You did well too. I'm sorry for putting you through such a terrifying experience…
choice_data_list: No, thank you for protecting me.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Oh… It was nothing… I just did what I could.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Last night was a little frightening, but thanks to Manhattan Cafe's resilient response, I feel perfectly at ease as the morning comes.
